definitions.short: a Chaldaean or inhabitant of Chaldaea; by implication, a Magian or professional astrologer
definitions.full: H3779. Kasday כַּשְׂדָּ֑י proper name, of a people Chaldean (see Biblical Hebrew כַשְׂדִּים ); — absolute ׳כ Dan 2:10 ; emphatic כשדיא 5:30 Kt (Qr כַּשְׂדָּאָה ), כסדיא Ezra 5:12 Kt (Qr כַּסְדָּאָה ); plural absolute כַּשְׂדָּאִין 3:8 ; 5:11 , emphatic כשדיא Kt, כַּשְׂדָּאֵי Qr, Dan 2:5 , 10 ; 4:4 ; 5:7 ; — 1 Chaldean By race Dan 3:8 ; 5:30 ; Ezra 5:12 . 2 as learned, of the class of Magi (Biblical Hebrew ׳כ 1c ), Dan 2:5 , 10 (twice in verse); 4:4 ; 5:7 , 11 .
